text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come up with a strategy for Tosen Jordan to use in the Hopeful Stakes, but it seems to go over her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to switch gears, having her instead get a feel for the strategy by physically trying it out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After successfully digesting my strategy, she excitedly proclaims that her next goal is to win the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That means she's been studying up on different races on her own, an indicator of just how motivated she is.
